entries.notes: Verbatim copies, no local edits. openroad-docker.sh is taken because openroad-smoke-test.sh needs it as its docker route and setup-env.sh symlinks it as the openroad fallback; on this host the PATH openroad wrapper does not forward PLATFORM_DIR, so the smoke test passes only via openroad-docker.sh (run with the host openroad off PATH). Not taken: scripts/spice_lef_parsing.py (unrelated), docs/environment.md and verification/check_pins.py (the setup script's comments point at them; this repo records pins in flow/smoke/records/environment.json instead).

Harness shape only (cocotb DUT helpers, record checker, gate-level pattern). No file content is vendored; the runner and checker here are new and much smaller. Pins to be revisited with the environment pin (#3).
